transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, well, I came in because for a long time now, I've just been walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. Like, even when work is going fine or people are nice to me, I still just feel down. It's just this kind of empty feeling most days, and I figured I should probably finally talk to someone about it.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been more like a couple of weeks, or has it been going on for months or even years?

Um, definitely longer than a couple of weeks. It's been going on for years, actually. I'd say it's been about two years and two months. It started right around the time this dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
Over these past two years, have there been any stretches of two months or longer where you felt essentially back to your normal self, without the low, empty feeling?

No, not really. I mean, there might be a day or two here and there where I'm distracted or something, but... no, there hasn't been a time where it just went away for a couple of months. It's pretty much always there in the background.
During this time, have you noticed your energy levels being low or feeling tired most days?

Yeah, definitely. I'm just... tired all the time. By the afternoon, I'm so wiped out that even doing basic stuff, like fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing up expense paperwork, feels impossible. It's like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud. I can't even get myself to go to soccer anymore. It just takes too much out of me.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual, during this time?

No, not really. My sleep hasn't really changed. I don't have trouble falling asleep or anything, and I'm not sleeping all day. I usually get a normal amount of sleep... it's just that, like I said, I still wake up feeling completely exhausted no matter what.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past two years, such as eating much more or much less than usual?
No, my appetite has been pretty normal. I... I eat about the same amount I always have, and my weight hasn't really changed or anything.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions during this time?
No, I haven't really noticed any problems with that. I mean, I can still focus on my work and make decisions just fine. It's really just the exhaustion that gets in the way, not my concentration.
Over these past two years, have you noticed feeling down on yourself or having low self-esteem?

Yeah, I do. Um, especially at work. Like, people will still bring up this dashboard I built, and honestly, my first thought is always that I somehow fooled them into thinking I know what I'm doing. And if I miss a follow-up or send an email late, it just feels like proof that I’m not actually as capable as they think I am.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal, even if it felt good at the time?

No, I've never felt anything like that. I mean, I never really have bursts of energy or feel unusually happy. And I definitely don't need less sleep... like I said, I'm pretty much just exhausted all the time. So, no, nothing like that.
